shield.description: Grants a shield that prevents damage taken for three guesses and restores 1 hp if guessed correctly while shield is active. You better not fail now.

unlock.description: Unlocks all songs for the current game with their full duration. Need an easy mode?

skip_round.description: Skips the current round and moves to the next one. Embarrasing.

extra_life.description: Trades a bonus point for an extra life. Good luck.
